channel.title: Decantified — Newest Arrivals
channel.description: Newest perfume decant arrivals at Decantified

item.title: Kenzo Homme Eau de Parfum by Kenzo – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Original Composition
Type:
Price: 3.99 - 32.00 (5 variants)

The original, not a tribute to one. Quentin Bisch built Kenzo Homme Eau de Parfum on three ideas and nothing else — sea notes, leather and patchouli — and the restraint is the point. It opens salty and ozonic, turns supple and animalic as the leather arrives, and dries down earthy. One of the more distinctive marine fragrances a designer house has put out.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Sea Notes
Middle: Leather
Base: Patchouli

item.title: Gas by Bujairami – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Often compared to Creed Aventus Cologne
Type:
Price: 2.49 - 22.50 (5 variants)

Gas is Bujairami's run at Aventus Cologne, and the pyramid tracks it closely — pink pepper and ginger over citrus, a woody heart of sandalwood, patchouli and vetiver, then tonka, styrax and birch underneath. Fresh and spicy at the opening, drier and woodier as it settles. Composed by Adam Bujairami.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Pink Pepper, Mandarin Orange, Bergamot, Spearmint, Ginger
Middle: Ozonic Notes, Sandalwood, Patchouli, Vetiver
Base: Tonka Bean, Styrax, Cedar, Birch, Musk

item.title: Milk Drops by Mykonos – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Original Composition
Type:
Price: 2.45 - 22.16 (5 variants)

Milk Drops is the lactonic one in Mykonos's Drops line. Milk, caramel and vanilla up front give it a soft powdery sweetness, tea and almond keep it from going flat, and sandalwood, cedar and musk take it into a skin-like drydown. Comforting and close to the skin rather than a projector — reviewers call it powdery first and sweet second.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Milk, Vanilla, Caramel
Middle: Tea, Rose, Almond
Base: Musk, Vanilla, Sandalwood, Cedarwood

item.title: Infina by Maison Asrar – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Original Composition
Type:
Price: 2.45 - 22.16 (5 variants)

Infina is Maison Asrar's woody marine. Pink pepper, cardamom and bergamot open sharp over a cool sea-air accord, then smoky incense and cashmere woods move in underneath. It finishes mossy and musky rather than clean-fresh, which is what separates it from the usual aquatic.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Pink Pepper, Marine Accord, Cardamom, Bergamot
Middle: Cashmere Wood, Incense, Amber
Base: Musk, Amber, Moss

item.title: Veyra by Maison Asrar – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Original Composition
Type:
Price: 2.45 - 22.16 (5 variants)

Veyra is a fruity floral with a gourmand streak running through it. Pomegranate, blackcurrant and mandarin give it a juicy opening, Bulgarian rose and magnolia carry the middle, and a caramel facet warms it before peach, vanilla and ambergris settle in. Bright at the top, creamy underneath.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Pomegranate, Blackcurrant, Bergamot, Mandarin
Middle: Caramel, Lily of the Valley, Magnolia, Bulgarian Rose
Base: Peach, Vanilla, Ambrette, Ambergris

item.title: Vanilla Seduction by Maison Asrar – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Original Composition
Type:
Price: 2.25 - 20.35 (5 variants)

Vanilla Seduction is the darker, fruitier half of Maison Asrar's vanilla pair. Plum and jasmine open it, brown sugar and caramel thicken the middle, and a trail of tonka, amber and patchouli keeps it from turning into dessert. Warm and close-wearing rather than loud.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Plum, Jasmine, Lily of the Valley
Middle: Vanilla, Brown Sugar, Caramel
Base: Tonka, Amber, Patchouli, Musk

item.title: Replica By the Fireplace by Maison Margiela – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Original Composition
Type:
Price: 3.99 - 32.00 (5 variants)

The original, not a tribute to one. Maison Margiela's Replica By the Fireplace bottles the smell of a log fire in winter: clove and pink pepper crackling over roasted chestnut, guaiac wood and juniper smoke, settling into vanilla, Peru balsam and soft cashmeran. Composed by Marie Salamagne in 2015, it is the reference point a whole generation of cosy-smoky fragrances has been chasing.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Cloves, Pink Pepper, Orange Blossom
Middle: Chestnut, Guaiac Wood, Juniper
Base: Vanilla, Peru Balsam, Cashmeran

item.title: Vanilla Aura by Maison Asrar – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Often compared to Guerlain Vanille Planifolia
Type:
Price: 2.25 - 20.35 (5 variants)

Vanilla Aura is Maison Asrar's much-talked-about take on a grown-up vanilla. Lemon and bergamot open it bright, a creamy heart of caramel, chocolate and vanilla fills in behind, and it dries down into amber, sandalwood and tonka. It reads ambery and resinous rather than sugary-edible, and the longevity is what people keep writing home about.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Lily of the Valley, Bergamot, Lemon
Middle: Vanilla, Chocolate, Caramel
Base: Vanilla, Amber, Sandalwood, Tonka

item.title: Modhesh Aura by Zimaya – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Often compared to Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Elixir
Type: Fragrance Decant
Price: 1.99 - 34.99 (5 variants)

Overview

Modhesh Aura by Zimaya is the one reviewers keep calling a 1:1 take on Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Elixir — the same lavender-and-mint opening over a thick vanilla and tonka base, with a pineapple twist the original doesn't have.

Bergamot, lavender, mint and soft woods open it fresh, cardamom, benzoin, dry amber and pineapple warm the heart, and it settles into vanilla, tonka bean and musk. A touch airier and less cloying than the original, which makes it easier to wear in warm weather.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Lavender, Mint, Bergamot, Woody Notes
Middle: Cardamom, Benzoin, Dry Amber, Pineapple
Base: Vanilla, Tonka Bean, Musk

Concentration: Eau de Parfum · Gender: Masculine

Decanted by hand from an authentic bottle into glass atomizers.

item.title: Stardust by Afnan – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Often compared to By Kilian Angels' Share
Type: Fragrance Decant
Price: 2.49 - 22.50 (5 variants)

Overview

Stardust by Afnan is a boozy oriental-woody Extrait whose cognac, cinnamon and caramel heart puts it squarely next to By Kilian Angels' Share — with a sparkling citrus opening the original doesn't have.

Aldehydes, bergamot, grapefruit, orange and mandarin give it lift, the cognac accord turns it warm and liqueur-like, and the base runs deep on amber, myrrh, sandalwood, oak, tonka and musk. Cold-weather and night-time material.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Aldehydes, Bergamot, Grapefruit, Orange, Mandarin Orange
Middle: Cognac, Cinnamon, Caramel
Base: Amber, Myrrh, Sandalwood, Tonka Bean, Oak, Woody Notes, Musk

Concentration: Extrait de Parfum · Gender: Unisex

Decanted by hand from an authentic bottle into glass atomizers.

item.title: Hawas Boa by Rasasi – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Original Composition
Type: Fragrance Decant
Price: 2.49 - 22.50 (5 variants)

Overview

Hawas Boa is Rasasi's tropical turn on the Hawas line, made in collaboration with fragrance reviewer FragranceFlan. Madagascar pomelo, prickly pear and green apple open it juicy and sun-soaked, with orange blossom softening the edges.

The heart brings tonka, driftwood and a thread of olibanum for a salty, resinous lift, and it dries down warm on vanilla and vetiver. Fruity and beachy up front, woody and grown-up underneath.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Madagascar Pomelo, Prickly Pear, Green Apple, Orange Blossom
Middle: Tonka Bean, Driftwood, Olibanum
Base: Vanilla, Vetiver

Concentration: Eau de Parfum · Gender: Masculine

Decanted by hand from an authentic bottle into glass atomizers.

item.title: Oud and Lychee by Swiss Arabian – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Original Composition
Type: Fragrance Decant
Price: 1.99 - 20.00 (5 variants)

Overview

Oud and Lychee by Swiss Arabian is a fruity-vanilla oud from the house's own ingredient-pairing line. Saffron and juicy lychee open it, rose, peach and raspberry fill the heart, and a single precious drop of oud anchors the base alongside vanilla and teak wood.

Sweet and golden rather than medicinal — the oud is there for warmth and depth, not smoke. Best in cool weather.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Saffron, Lychee
Middle: Rose, Peach, Raspberry
Base: Vanilla, Oud, Teak Wood

Concentration: Eau de Parfum · Gender: Feminine

Decanted by hand from an authentic bottle into glass atomizers.

item.title: Bergamot and Patchouli by Swiss Arabian – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Often compared to Creed Aventus
Type: Fragrance Decant
Price: 1.99 - 20.00 (5 variants)

Overview

Bergamot and Patchouli by Swiss Arabian is a bright fruity-woody masculine built on the same skeleton as Creed Aventus — bergamot, pineapple and blackcurrant up top, patchouli, musk and amber underneath.

Lily of the valley keeps the heart clean and a little green, and the drydown is warm and smooth rather than smoky. An easy daily wear and a cheap way to scratch the Aventus itch.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Bergamot, Pineapple, Black Currant
Middle: Lily of the Valley
Base: Patchouli, Musk, Amber

Concentration: Eau de Parfum · Gender: Masculine

Decanted by hand from an authentic bottle into glass atomizers.

item.title: Musk 74 Poudré by Swiss Arabian – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Original Composition
Type: Fragrance Decant
Price: 2.99 - 25.00 (5 variants)

Overview

Musk 74 Poudré by Swiss Arabian is a soft, powdery musk Extrait from the house's own numbered ingredient line — the same series as Vanilla 01 and Patchouli 01.

Aldehydes and ylang give it a clean, retro-cosmetic shimmer, heliotrope, iris and white flowers make the heart quietly floral, and it finishes on powdery musk, creamy vanilla and a balsamic warmth. A skin scent in the best sense — comforting and close.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Musk, Aldehydes, Ylang-Ylang
Middle: White Musk, Heliotrope, Iris, White Flowers
Base: Powdery Musk, Creamy Vanilla, Balsamic Accord

Concentration: Extrait de Parfum · Gender: Feminine

Decanted by hand from an authentic bottle into glass atomizers.

item.title: Siralia by Nayaat – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Often compared to Tom Ford Lost Cherry
Type: Fragrance Decant
Price: 2.25 - 20.35 (5 variants)

Overview

Siralia by Nayaat opens on ripe cherry, pear and red fruits, then turns floral through rose and jasmine sambac before settling into ambroxan, tonka bean, oakmoss and benzoin.

That cherry-and-jasmine-sambac structure over a warm tonka base puts it in Tom Ford Lost Cherry territory, with a drier, mossier finish. Rich and attention-getting — an evening scent.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Cherry, Pear, Red Fruits
Middle: Rose, Jasmine Sambac
Base: Ambroxan, Tonka Bean, Oakmoss, Benzoin

Concentration: Eau de Parfum · Gender: Unisex

Decanted by hand from an authentic bottle into glass atomizers.

item.title: Rome Pink PP Vanille by Mast Perfume – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Inspired by Valentino Donna Born in Roma Pink PP
Type: Fragrance Decant
Price: 1.99 - 20.00 (5 variants)

Overview

Rome Pink PP Vanille by Mast Perfume is a sweet floral-vanilla take on Valentino Donna Born in Roma Pink PP, which it names outright.

Bright Calabrian mandarin opens it, orange blossom carries the heart, and warm bourbon vanilla runs through the drydown with a soft woody edge. Sugary, feminine and built for cooler weather and evenings.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Calabrian Mandarin
Middle: Orange Blossom
Base: Bourbon Vanilla, Woody Notes

Mast Perfume does not publish its own pyramid for this one; the notes above are those of the Valentino original it reproduces.

Concentration: Eau de Parfum · Gender: Feminine

Decanted by hand from an authentic bottle into glass atomizers.

item.title: Hulm by Riiffs – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Often compared to Narciso Rodriguez Musc Noir Rose
Type: Fragrance Decant
Price: 2.25 - 20.35 (5 variants)

Overview

Hulm by Riiffs is a graceful floral-fruity Extrait that opens on juicy raspberry, plum and peach nectar lifted by rose de mai, then blooms into peony, tuberose and powdery orris.

It dries down soft and skin-close on white musk and Iso E Super — the fruit, soft-floral and musk structure that reviewers compare to Narciso Rodriguez Musc Noir Rose. Pretty, feminine and easy to over-spray in the best way.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Raspberry, Plum, Peach Nectar, Rose de Mai
Middle: Peony, Tuberose, Orris Root
Base: White Musk, Iso E Super

Concentration: Extrait de Parfum · Gender: Feminine (listed unisex on Fragrantica)

Decanted by hand from an authentic bottle into glass atomizers.

item.title: Librae by Maison Asrar – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Original Composition
Type: Fragrance Decant
Price: 2.49 - 22.50 (5 variants)

Overview

Librae by Maison Asrar is a balanced oriental-woody unisex scent — bright citrus and aromatic spice up top, soft florals and powder through the middle, and a calm drydown of sandalwood, moss and musk.

Easy-going rather than loud, and comfortable in any season. Reviewers most often reach for Armani Stronger With You Sandalwood when describing it.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Citrus, Aromatic Notes, Spicy Notes
Middle: Powdery Notes, Floral Notes, Woody Notes
Base: Sandalwood, Musk, Moss

Concentration: Eau de Parfum · Gender: Unisex

Decanted by hand from an authentic bottle into glass atomizers.

item.title: Spartacus by Armaf – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Often compared to Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Elixir Absolu
Type: Fragrance Decant
Price: 2.49 - 22.50 (5 variants)

Overview

Spartacus by Armaf is a bold aromatic-woody-vanilla scent for men, most often compared to Jean Paul Gaultier Le Male Elixir Absolu — the same warm, edible vanilla-and-praline character, with Parfums de Marly Althaïr in the same conversation.

It opens bright and spicy on bergamot, cardamom and cinnamon with a juicy plum and orange blossom lift, then turns soft and edible through lavender, davana, elemi, bourbon vanilla and candied almond. The base settles in for the long haul: praline, tonka bean, benzoin, amber, patchouli, labdanum and guaiac wood over clean musk. Sweet but not syrupy, and best in cool weather or at night.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Bergamot, Cardamom, Cinnamon, Orange Blossom, Plum
Middle: Lavender, Davana, Elemi, Bourbon Vanilla, Candied Almond
Base: Praline, Musk, Tonka Bean, Benzoin, Amber, Patchouli, Labdanum, Guaiac Wood

Concentration: Eau de Parfum · Gender: Masculine

item.title: Onyx Silver by Khadlaj – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Original Composition
Type: Fragrance Decant
Price: 2.25 - 20.35 (5 variants)

Overview

Onyx Silver by Khadlaj is a fresh-spicy woody masculine. Bergamot, ginger and black pepper give it a sharp, peppery opening.

Petitgrain and cardamom keep the heart green and aromatic, and it settles into a warm sweet-woody base of patchouli, labdanum, benzoin and tonka bean. Crisp up top, rich underneath — an easy year-round pick.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Bergamot, Ginger, Black Pepper
Middle: Petitgrain, Cardamom
Base: Patchouli, Labdanum, Benzoin, Tonka Bean

Concentration: Eau de Parfum · Gender: Masculine

item.title: Bravanzo Imperial by Dumont – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Often compared to Electimus Imperium
Type: Fragrance Decant
Price: 2.75 - 24.80 (5 variants)

Overview

Bravanzo Imperial by Dumont (Ramon Blazar) is a citrus-woody Extrait most often compared to Electimus Imperium, with a nod to the bright, resinous side of Mancera Cedrat Boisée.

Grapefruit, bergamot and pink pepper open it sharp and spicy, oakmoss, incense and cashmere wood build the heart, and it dries down on amber, patchouli, ambergris and white musk. Loud, polished and long-lasting.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Grapefruit, Bergamot, Pink Pepper
Middle: Oakmoss, Incense, Cashmere Wood
Base: Amber, Patchouli, Ambergris, White Musk

Concentration: Extrait de Parfum · Gender: Unisex

item.title: Marasi For Her by Arabiyat Prestige – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Original Composition
Type: Fragrance Decant
Price: 2.25 - 20.35 (5 variants)

Overview

Marasi For Her by Arabiyat Prestige is a sweet floral-fruity gourmand. Hazelnut, raspberry, mango and bergamot open it up.

A playful heart of cotton candy, violet, orange blossom and patchouli follows, and it lands on vanilla, tonka bean, caramel and musk. Dessert-sweet and cosy — a strong cold-weather and date-night pick.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Hazelnut, Raspberry, Mango, Bergamot
Middle: Patchouli, Cotton Candy, Violet, Orange Blossom
Base: Vanilla, Tonka Bean, Musk, Caramel

Concentration: Eau de Parfum · Gender: Feminine

item.title: Asteria by Velixir – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Often compared to Louis Vuitton City of Stars
Type: Fragrance Decant
Price: 2.75 - 24.80 (5 variants)

Overview

Asteria by Velixir is a bright floral-woody musk often compared to Louis Vuitton City of Stars. It opens on a burst of blood orange, mandarin, bergamot and lemon.

Creamy tiare flower softens the heart, and it settles on sandalwood, musk and powdery notes. Clean, sunny and effortless, with a soft skin-scent drydown.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Blood Orange, Mandarin Orange, Bergamot, Lemon
Middle: Tiare Flower
Base: Sandalwood, Musk, Powdery Notes

Concentration: Eau de Parfum · Gender: Unisex

item.title: Throne Eclipse by Maison Asrar – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Often compared to Parfums de Marly Layton
Type: Fragrance Decant
Price: 2.49 - 22.50 (5 variants)

Overview

Throne Eclipse by Maison Asrar is the darker, after-dark chapter of the Throne line, and its apple-and-spice opening over a creamy vanilla base puts it in the same family as Parfums de Marly Layton.

Crisp apple meets clove and cardamom up top, cinnamon, geranium and lavender warm the heart, and it finishes on vanilla, amber and cedarwood. Rich, sweet-spicy and built for cold weather.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Apple, Clove, Cardamom
Middle: Cinnamon, Geranium, Lavender
Base: Vanilla, Amber, Cedarwood

Concentration: Eau de Parfum · Gender: Unisex

item.title: Amalfi Bianco Pour Homme by Jo Milano – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Original Composition
Type: Fragrance Decant
Price: 2.25 - 20.35 (5 variants)

Overview

Amalfi Bianco Pour Homme by Jo Milano is a smoky-fresh masculine inspired by the Amalfi Coast. Bright bergamot opens it, an aromatic heart of lavender and a warm fire accord gives it depth.

It finishes on woody notes and soft smoke — a refined, memorable trail that works best in cooler weather and after dark.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Bergamot
Middle: Lavender, Fire Accord
Base: Woody Notes, Smoke

Concentration: Eau de Parfum · Gender: Masculine
